facts.max_credit: Cloudflare for Startups gives early-stage companies up to $350k in credits to build the next big idea. / Receive up to $350,000 in credits for a year to support your startup. The program is structured around where you are in your journey. / Tier 3 — $10k: Get started with $10k in credits to build and launch your product, no minimum funding required. / Tier 2 — $100k: Access expanded $100k in credits, an account manager, and technical sessions with Cloudflare experts. / Tier 1 — $350k: Unlock $350k maximum credits, Office Hours with experts, and priority technical support to scale globally.
facts.eligibility: You qualify if your startup meets all of the following: Founded within the last 10 years — Your company was incorporated no more than 10 years ago; Funded up to Series B — Funded within the last 12 months; Building a technology product — Actively developing a technology product; Has a valid, publicly accessible website — Your startup has a live website we can verify; Active on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), or GitHub — Your startup has a public social media presence; Has not previously been approved into the program — First-time applicants only; For-profit business with a business email matching your domain — Business email required — no personal email addresses. / Tier-specific Criteria: Tier 3: Bootstrapped or self-funded; Under $1M raised. Tier 2: Under $5M raised; Funded by an affiliated partner. Tier 1: $5M+ raised; Funded by an affiliated partner.
facts.usable_services: Credits cover usage-based services. Core security and networking features are included at no cost, regardless of tier. / Covered by Credits (Usage-based services deducted from your credit balance): Compute — Workers, Workers for Platforms, Durable Objects, Workflows; AI — Workers AI (up to $50,000); Storage & Data — Workers KV, D1, Queues, Vectorize, R2 (up to $10,000); Delivery — Pages, Images and Stream, Cache Reserve, Argo Smart Routing. / Included at No Cost (Core security and networking features for every tier): Three enterprise domains, Unlimited Business and Pro plans; DDoS and bot protection, WAF with 1,000 custom rules, Security Analytics, SSL certificates, Page Shield; CDN and DNS, Load Balancing (2 origins), Rate Limiting (1 rule), 100% SLA.
facts.prepaid_conditions: Credits are valid for one year or until fully consumed, whichever comes first. We are not able to approve extensions at this time. / Product-Specific Caps & Exclusions: R2 Object Storage: Covered up to a $10,000 cap. Workers AI: Covered up to a $2,500 cap for Tier 3, $10,000 for Tier 2, and $50,000 for Tier 1 (standard partner model pricing applies). AI Gateway: Temporarily not covered by credits. We are actively working to make it accessible.
facts.terms_text: What's not covered? The following products and services are currently excluded from Startup Program credit coverage: AI Gateway: Temporarily not covered by credits. Registrar Services: Domain registration and renewal fees are not eligible for credit deductions. Enterprise Feature Add-Ons: These are excluded by default, but you can request access by emailing us at startups@cloudflare.com. Premium Network Services: Magic Transit, Enterprise Spectrum, Dedicated IPs, and the China Network are excluded and require a dedicated contracted plan. / Who isn't a good fit? Right now, this program isn't open to educational institutions, personal blogs, consultancies, service-based agencies, MSPs, or resellers. / (FAQ) We recently updated our program tiers, increasing Tier 3 from $5,000 to $10,000 ... and increasing Tier 1 from $250,000 to $350,000. If approved for an upgrade ... this does not reset your 1-year program expiration date. The additional credits will still expire at the end of your original 12-month cohort window.
